cards.blurbHtml: My 3D Flash game from before Stage3D. Papervision3D then Away3DLite faking 3D on the CPU, Box2D then Nape physics: a 2.5D physics platformer with a real level editor, rope bridges, joints and triggers. Rebooted once in FlashPunk. Never finished.
